**Join us at Hillebrand Gori – a company of DHL Global Forwarding**


**Introduction**  

Being specialized in alcoholic beverages, we offer a full range of transportation services and options, from full container loads to groupage shipments, from large volumes of bulk wine to small consignments via airfreight. Our logistics services allow our customers to transport exactly what they want, when they want, in a cost\-effective way.


To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are expanding our software development team with a **T\-SQL developer with C\# or C\+\+ knowledge**. In this role, you will join our software development department of 35 professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. You will work on our main transport management system, helping us make the application future ready, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build in\-house, business\-driven applications.


Our architecture is API first and cloud native, using Angular and Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. We are currently migrating our transport management system to this architecture.


**Why work at Hillebrand Gori?**


With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. Our success is built on the dedication of our people. While we operate globally with more than 2,200 employees, our IT department is largely located in The Netherlands but also has a presence in Italy, France and India. Within our department around 15 different nationalities work together.

* Design, Develop, and maintain the T\-SQL code within the MS SQL server environment, ensuring high performance, data integrity, and security
* Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions for data extraction and manipulation
* Optimize database performance through indexing strategies and query tuning
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
* Write and maintain technical documentation

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of experience in MS SQL server development
* Experience with version control systems (Git)
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
* Experience with Agile development methodologies
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Extra; Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure) or willing to learn
* Good command of the English language (spoken and written)

Currently living in The Netherlands within a normal commute of Haarlem

  



**Preferred qualifications**


* Proficiency in C\# for REST API development OR C\+\+ for front\-end application development

**What can you expect from us?**


* A salary tailored to your qualities and experience
* A contract for 40 hours
* Reimbursement for travel expenses, work from home allowance and internet allowance
* Pension scheme with BeFrank
* Flexible working hours and possibility to work from home
* Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities to realize your ambitions in an international environment
* An informal working environment with innovative colleagues who strive for the very best
* You can work independently and make us better with your own input

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET
jobs.description:
Role Overview  

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer (C\#) to join the Acquisitions \& Originations engineering team within Experian's Credit \& Verification Services business.

**The Domain**


The Acquisitions \& Originations team develops and provides level 3 support for the Delphi Select and Evaluate platforms, which are used across the Acquisitions and Originations business. These are complex, configuration\-driven, multi\-client systems: each client (bank, lender or other financial institution) runs its own decisioning strategies, rules and data configurations on a shared codebase.


Clients depend on these systems to make real\-time lending and origination decisions, so reliability, data integrity and controlled release processes are central to the role.


This is a hybrid, Nottingham based role (40% in the office) reporting to the Lead Developer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own features end\-to\-end across the full software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit and integration testing, code review, deployment and post\-release support.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable, maintainable C\#/.NET services and components within a complex, multi\-client system, ensuring changes are safe across all client configurations.
* Translate high\-level and client\-specific requirements into robust technical designs, in collaboration with the Technical Lead, Architects, Business Analysts and Product Owners.
* Maintain and improve automated test coverage (unit, integration and regression) to support safe, frequent releases into a live multi\-client platform.
* Contribute to and help evolve CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins)
* Identify and help remediate technical debt, and contribute to ongoing modernisation of the platform, including its migration towards cloud\-native (AWS) architecture.
* Mentor Intermediate and Junior developers, sharing technical knowledge and supporting their growth, including in the effective use of AI\-assisted development tools.

  

  

Experience and Skills  

**Required Skills / Knowledge**

* Strong expertise in .NET Core / .NET Framework and C\#, including object\-oriented design and common design patterns.
* Proven experience across the full software development lifecycle, ideally supporting a live, business\-critical production system.
* Solid experience with SQL Server / T\-SQL, including writing and optimising queries and stored procedures against production data.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, and working with service\-oriented or microservice architectures.
* Practical experience with unit and integration testing frameworks (e.g. xUnit, NUnit or MSTest).
* Experience with version control and CI/CD tooling (e.g. Git, Jenkins, or equivalent).
* Direct experience working in a Scrum or other Agile team, including sprint planning, stand\-ups and retrospectives.
* Hands\-on, everyday experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, test writing, debugging and documentation

**Useful Skills (beneficial, not mandatory)**

* Exposure to AWS services (e.g. DynamoDB, S3, EC2 ) or a strong interest in developing cloud skills as the platform migrates to AWS.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Knowledge of containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience in financial services, lending, credit decisioning or a similarly regulated domain.
* Exposure to front\-end technologies such as React or modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with configuration\-driven or rules\-engine\-based systems.

  

  

About Experian  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Indra Park Air work with customers all over the globe to make air travel safer. For over 50 years we’ve been one of the leading producers of VHF and UHF radios, providing the vital link between the ground and the air for passenger, freight and military aircraft.


The reasons behind our success are simple and won’t change. First, we work harder for the customer than the rest. We take time to truly know their needs and create the right product for them. We train them how to use it, we won’t let our equipment be deployed until every detail is right, and then we provide the best care and service for all our products.


At Indra Park Air we stay the best by looking to the future – to new requirements and new possibilities. A radio remains a radio, but we never stop thinking about how we can improve it, and how it can offer more to our customers. It’s no wonder that we are one of only 2% of companies worldwide to hold PLATINUM Level in Investors in People Accreditation.


At Indra Park Air, our values guide everything we do, from developing industry\-leading technology to supporting our customers around the world.

**Innovation** \- Our capacity for innovation, cutting\-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enable us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

**Trust** \- We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

**Connection** \- We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

**Foresight** \- We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.


As **Senior Project Engineer** you coordinate and organise project activities and the development team to deliver internal and 3rd development project and report status.

**What you will do:**

* Ensure key documents are released and kept up to date, such as Project Quality Plan, Product Release Plan, Statement Of Work
* Work with the Project Lead to Plan and document project activities with support from Project Owner and Product Architect
* Identify human resource requirements
* Schedule activities to meet roadmap commitments. Track task completion and ensure tasks are kept upto date by engineers.
* Understand and document risks and their mitigations, with support from the technical team
* Liaise with the project Lead and team members to understand, monitor and report project status
* Assist the project Lead to deliver the project
* Support the generation and documentation of project requirements
* At the beginning of the project ensure all equipment required throughout the project is identified, and is available to the project team when it is needed
* Manage ordering of prototype PCBs, metalwork and other items ensuring these are available when needed
* Promptly escalate any issues preventing the team from achieving planned progress
* Organise appropriate review meetings and chair those delegated by the Product Engineering Manager
* Perform role of Project Engineer for several concurrent and/or large projects
* Manage and coordinate outsourced development projects with the 3rd party provider, reporting status, ensuring any internal dependencies are provided on time and loan equipment is arranged
* Drive the delivery of Project roadmap activities and support resource planning activities for the department managers.
* Support the department and department manager on related departmental activities.
* Keep internal stakeholders outside of Product Engineering up to date. Programme Management, Procurement and Operations.

**Accountabilities:**

* Work independently without guidance or direction
* Use best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to lead products/services or process improvements
* Identify, research, develop and drive forward ways of improving company technical performance
* Regularly monitor progress against goals and reorganise/rewrite plans to deal with change

**Commercial Awareness:**

* Understand how all engineering tasks impact non\-engineering internal and external customers

**Quality and Ethics:**

* Demonstrate flexibility and a positive attitude to changing priorities or direction
* Demonstrate excellent team working skills working collaboratively in own department, across the company and with external customers, suppliers and agencies
* Comply with company and departmental procedures
* Adopt a quality approach and foster a quality culture
* Contribute to process improvements
* Show the highest level of commitment to delivering exceptional customer service
* Understand and conform to the standards contained in the Company Standards of Business Ethics

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications**

* First\-class or upper\-second\-class (2:1\) degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant technical or engineering discipline.
* Strong academic background in Mathematics and Science, demonstrated through A Level or equivalent qualifications.

**Knowledge and/or practical experience in some of the following areas:**

* The full product development lifecycle, from concept and design through to verification, manufacture and product introduction.
* Project planning and management tools, such as MS Project, Jira or equivalent.
* MRP/ERP systems, such as SAP or equivalent.
* Communications and modulation techniques.
* Electronic circuit design, prototyping and development.
* Analogue, digital and RF electronics.
* FPGA design and firmware development.
* Software design and development methodologies.
* Embedded software design and implementation.
* Programming languages such as C, C\+\+, C\#, Python, HTML and JavaScript.
* Digital Signal Processing (DSP) techniques.
* Basic network technologies and communication protocols.
* Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) of mechanical parts and assemblies.
* Introduction of new products into a manufacturing environment.


Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed above; a broad technical foundation and the ability to develop knowledge in new areas are important.

**Work Experience**

* Previous experience in a design engineering or product development role.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team would be advantageous.

**Personal Skills and Abilities**

* Strong interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with a range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to plan ahead, identify potential issues and take appropriate action to support long\-term project objectives.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage competing tasks and deliver against project objectives.
* Highly self\-motivated, adaptable and positive, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks and responsibilities.
* Practical, hands\-on approach to engineering and problem solving.
* Customer\-focused, with an understanding of customer requirements and the ability to develop effective engineering solutions.

  

**Benefits**  

* Flexitime and core hours – 37\.5 hrs a week, core hrs between 0930\-1500
* Enhanced Holiday – 25 days plus bank holidays
* Enhanced Pension Scheme – up to 8% company contribution
* Life Assurance
* Liberty Days \- you can request up to 3 days of your annual leave ‘on the day’
* Buying and Selling Holidays
* Long service and retirement awards
* Private healthcare
* Flu vaccinations
* Cycle to work scheme
* Subsidised staff canteen
* Free parking
* Training
* Continuous Learning

Requisition ID: 19418

**WHO IS HOLCIM?**
  

As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of our strategy, we are becoming a net\-zero company, with our people and communities at the heart of our success. It’s all thanks to our 70,000 talented people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready\-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions \& Products.


**WHO ARE HOLCIM PEOPLE**
  

Holcim people are passionate about finding better ways to build. They embrace innovation and improvement with a pioneering spirit. They work as trusted partners, creating better solutions and experiences for their customers, communities, and colleagues.


Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15\.7 billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 50 000 employees in 45 countries – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East \& Africa – and has been recognized as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundation and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet, ECOCycle, and Ytong.

  

**Role Overview**

  

The **Operational Technology Engineer** is a specialized strategic role focused on the design, deployment, standardisation, and governance of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) \- internally identified as Technical Information Systems (TIS). Acting as the critical bridge between TIS, ICS and the ERP, this role ensures the integrity, cyber\-resilience and continuous availability of operational data across the global organization.  

  

  

  

This role requires an innovative engineer to drive automation and digital transformation by serving high\-fidelity data to advanced analytics, IIoT platforms, and optimization tools. The ideal candidate thrives in a high\-performance culture, demonstrates a strong commitment to operational sustainability, and acts as a catalyst for continuous learning and technology adoption.  

  

  

**Main Responsibilities**

  

The Operational Technology Engineer plays a critical role in standardizing and optimizing automation systems to capture, analyse, and leverage production data, driving operational efficiency across all industrial processes.  

  

  

**1\. Strategy \& Standardization**  

* Collaborate in define and implement corporate\-wide ICS/TIS standards to ensure global consistency in KPIs, reporting structures, and data architecture across 100\+ plants

* Align OT strategy in line with corporate guidance with business goals, identifying emerging technology needs and establishing multi\-year technical roadmaps.

* Drive innovation and industrial transformation: implement Plant of Tomorrow (PoT) solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

* Train and mentor the OT plant teams: build high\-performing operational plant teams through training and development, focusing on ICS and TIS systems.

* Educate and advise plant OT related risks and opportunities

* Support the product roadmap for new functionalities and features within the PCS/MES ecosystem.

* Design and maintain robust interfaces between the shop floor (PCS/DCS), laboratory (LIMS), and business layers (SAP).

  

  

  

**2\. Global Deployment \& Operations**  

* Support the full lifecycle of ICS/MES deployments, from initial site assessment and vendor coordination to post\-go\-live support and version upgrades.

* Ensure reliability of the ICS/TIS environment, coordinating with IT and external vendors.

* Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot industrial data communication protocols and networking standards (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA/DA/HDA).

* Optimize production data streams to improve overall process efficiency and support decarbonization/sustainability goals.

  

  

**3\. Data Governance \& Security**  

* Uphold the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and confidentiality to support "Smart Operations" and advanced analytics.

* Collaborate with the Cybersecurity team to implement robust protective measures for OT data systems against evolving cyber threats.

* Maintain comprehensive documentation for data architecture and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  

  

**4\. Leadership \& Knowledge Management**  

* Design and execute global training programs to upskill plant\-level PCS, TIS, PIMS, and LIMS champions.

* Manage a centralized corporate knowledge base, including engineering standards, operational manuals and troubleshooting guides.

* Influence senior stakeholders and plant management to ensure buy\-in for digital initiatives and technical standards.

**5\. Collaboration \& Communication:**  

* Work cross\-functionally with Maintenance, Process/Production, Quality Control, Corporate IT, and PM\&E to ensure end\-to\-end system integration and alignment.

**6\. Operational Management**  

* Oversee site\-level OT performance, ensuring smooth, secure, and efficient multi\-plant operations. Implement and enforce cybersecurity measures: protect OT systems from cyber threats and vulnerabilities through OT cybersecurity controls.

  

  

**Your Profile**

  

**Level of education/qualifications normally required:**  

* MS or PhD in Electrical, Electronic, or Automation Engineering.

* (preferred) ISA/IEC 62443 OT cybersecurity certificate

  

  

**Experience**  

* 3 years’ experience as plant automation/systems engineer for process industry

* 3 years’ in managing industrial data systems (Historians, MES) and industrial networking.

* 3 years’ experience in cement (advantage)

  

  

**Technical / functional skills:**  

* Deep understanding of OT systems in the process industry: This includes industrial control systems, SCADA systems, distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and manufacturing execution systems.

* Understanding of OT security threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies. Familiarity with security frameworks and standards like IEC 62443\.

* Knowledge of industrial networking protocols like Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC UA.

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and IoT technologies relevant to industrial environments, JavaScript and prototyping languages such as Python

* In\-depth understanding of continuous cement manufacturing processes, instrumentation, and sensor technologies.

.  

**Language skills:**  

* English (technical fluency critical)

  

* Spanish, German and French are an advantage

  

  

  

**Mobility requirements:**

Full Stack Developer – HighFive (Tech Subsidiary of HF)

About HighFive

HighFive, the tech-focused subsidiary of HF, a UK based law firm, is redefining the insurance and legal industries through cutting-edge innovation. Evolving from an award-winning in-house innovation department into a standalone tech company, we combine deep industry expertise with ground-breaking technology to tackle real-world challenges head-on.

Born from a vision to disrupt the status quo, innovation has always driven us forward – but always with people at its core. As a trusted partner to many of the UK’s leading insurers, we are pioneering next-generation solutions using state-of-the-art technology and artificial intelligence combined with very human understanding and expertise to revolutionise claims management, data analysis, and customer value.

Our exciting AI product: ELI
, developed in partnership with The University of Salford and HF, is set to transform insurance claims handling using advanced technology that leverages HF’s expert legal knowledge. That’s people-powered technology.

We are currently looking for a Full Stack Developer
to join our growing team and help accelerate the delivery of ELI. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software that meets business and customer needs. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects in the insurtech and legal tech space.

Work across front-end and back-end technologies, ensuring best practices in architecture, design, and security.
Collaborate with stakeholders and product owners to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

Solid understanding of software development principles and best practices.

Building the future of technology starts with great developers.

At MAB, we're investing heavily in technology as we transform our digital landscape. We're moving from a traditional monolithic platform to a modern cloud-based microservices architecture, creating innovative products and services that support our advisers, business partners and customers across the UK.

As a Mid-Level Software Developer, you'll join a growing Technology team at an exciting stage of our journey. You'll work on meaningful projects, contribute to the development of modern applications and help deliver solutions that support the future of mortgage and financial services.

Whether your background is front-end, back-end or full stack development, this is a fantastic opportunity to work with modern technologies, collaborate with talented engineers and continue developing your technical expertise in a supportive Agile environment.

About The Role

Working as part of a collaborative Agile delivery team, you'll be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining software solutions that are scalable, reliable and aligned to business needs.

You'll contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from reviewing requirements and technical designs through to development, testing and deployment. Alongside delivering quality code, you'll help identify opportunities for improvement, share ideas with the wider team and contribute to the continued evolution of our technology platforms.

We are passionate about innovation and continuously explore emerging technologies, including AI, to improve the way we build and deliver solutions.

Designing, building and maintaining high-quality software solutions.
Developing clean, efficient and reusable code aligned to engineering best practice.
Reviewing technical specifications and solution designs before development begins.
Working within a modern microservices architecture to deliver scalable services and applications.
Collaborating with Product Owners, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers and fellow Developers throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Identifying opportunities to improve existing applications, services and development processes.
Participating in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
